prompt: Red finds a lost puppy in the park
title: Lost Puppy Found
irony: Red finds a lost puppy to keep for herself, but the only way to keep its love is to give it back to its owner.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Evening street glows under the lamp as a tiny brown puppy whimpers beside the bench.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Red scoops up the puppy, calls him Biscuit, and hides him with Navy and Green by the porch steps.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: A wet lost-poster flaps on the lamp post while the puppy howls at his own photo.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids gather round the shivering puppy and sing the lost-puppy hook together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Red feeds the puppy crisps from her pocket and the puppy sneezes, spills the juice, and bolts.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The leash loops round Navy as the muddy puppy races round the bench, dragging boots and coats.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chase the spinning leash circle and sing the lost-puppy hook again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold watches from his doorway, counts the cold coins in his palm, and remembers rainy-day soup.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold opens his warm doorway and invites the shivering kids and puppy inside to call the vet.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Red holds the collar tag up high as Gold sings the turned line and the kids cheer.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The owner hugs the puppy under the lamp as Red waves goodbye and shares her biscuits.
